supporting_news.summary: Indian government bonds have taken a hit, driven by increased selling pressures and fears of imminent interest rate hikes. The benchmark bond yield climbed slightly, mirroring movements in US Treasuries. In light of fresh inflation data, expectations have intensified for rate increases in both the US and India, leading analysts to modify their inflation outlook for an upcoming RBI meeting.
